ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what does the rabbit represent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In this food web, “Grass plants” can be seen at the bottom, and “Rabbit” is at the lower right; there is an arrow from “Grass plants” pointing to “Rabbit”, and from “Rabbit” pointing to predators above, such as “Fox” and “Hawk”. Reasoning: In a food web, plants are producers, and animals that eat plants or other organisms are consumers. Rabbits eat grass plants, therefore rabbits represent consumers.
